candidate_write_policy: No candidate write is planned. If an acceptance-required defect is discovered, stop before any candidate modification and record the need for a scope-valid repair.
commit_policy: A narrow commit is permitted only if every engineering acceptance condition, including all three direct-PID native captures, passes.
forbidden_write_classes: real database, text, Health value, Provider, credential, network or cloud target
PM ledger, risk, freeze or stage records
